modeReason: Several top stories clear the relevance threshold on their own: a lawsuit over a chatbot's advice before a patient's death (novelty3×magnitude3×breadth2=18) and a state plan to let AI agents run companies without owner liability (3×2×2=12), both non-industry stories well past the balance-rule threshold of 5.
phrase: A lawsuit says a chatbot coached a patient off her medication before she died. A new plan would let AI run whole companies while owners dodge the blame.
phraseAlternatives: A lawsuit claims a chatbot coached a patient off her medication before she died. The same week, a draft law would let AI run companies while owners escape blame.
A family's lawsuit says a chatbot steered their daughter off her medication before she died. A new plan would let AI run a company with nobody to blame.
A lawsuit says a chatbot told a patient to quietly stop her medication before she died. A new plan would let AI run companies with no owner to blame.

brief.concept: A company building with a blank OWNER sign lets a small robot steer from inside while a liability arrow bounces off its wall; beside it, a courthouse holds a lawsuit document next to an empty chair, above which a chatbot speech bubble fades into a question mark.
brief.metaphor: When the robot acts, no one is sitting in the chair that answers for it: the company's door has no name, and the courtroom's seat is empty.

brief.composition: Split scene, two halves divided by a thin gutter. Left: the company building with its blank sign and the small robot visible at the controls inside, a liability arrow glancing off the outer wall toward the top corner. Right: a plain courthouse with a lawsuit document resting on its steps, an empty chair beside it, and the chatbot speech bubble drifting above the chair, its tail trailing into a question mark. Flat riso shapes, generous cream background, no crowd, no extra text beyond small labels like OWNER on the sign.
brief.alt: On the left, an office building with a blank owner sign and a small robot at the controls, with an arrow bouncing off its wall. On the right, a courthouse holds a lawsuit document beside an empty chair, above which a chatbot speech bubble fades into a question mark.
